name: Capital One (credit cards)
why: Rank 1 in rankings/credit-cards.json (~100M customers, largest U.S. issuer by loans); dossier from earlier run kept.

name: Chase (credit cards)
why: Rank 2; #1 U.S. issuer by purchase volume (Freedom, Sapphire and many co-brands).

name: American Express
why: Rank 3; ~55M+ U.S. cards in force, own servicing site.

name: Synchrony Bank - store card servicer hub
why: Rank 4; ~70M active store/co-brand accounts; distinctive Pay as guest flow.

name: Citi (Citibank credit cards)
why: Rank 5; top-5 issuer. Citi Retail Services (rank 10) skipped: offline-template record and same company.

name: Bank of America (credit cards)
why: Rank 6; top-5 issuer with cards paid through Online Banking Pay Bills.

name: Wells Fargo (credit cards)
why: Rank 8; major national issuer; distinctive Relief Center payment assistance.

name: Bread Financial (Comenity)
why: Rank 9; ~30M+ store and co-brand accounts; EasyPay guest payment.

name: Credit One Bank
why: Rank 11; large national subprime issuer with a richly documented public payment FAQ.

name: U.S. Bank (credit cards)
why: Rank 15; major national bank issuer with its own servicing site. Chosen over Discover (rank 7), whose cardmembers are being moved onto Capital One servicing (pick 1) through 2026 and early 2027, and over the Amazon and Costco co-brands, which are serviced on the Chase and Citi sites already picked.

name: Apple Card
why: Rank 13; ~12M accounts (Goldman Sachs issuer, Chase transition announced); own servicing on card.apple.com and Wallet. Ranks 7, 10 and 12 skipped: Discover is now Capital One (pick 1) and mid-migration, Citi Retail Services is offline and Citi, Amazon Visa is serviced on Chase.

name: Barclays US (Barclaycard)
why: Rank 16; ~15M U.S. co-brand and Barclaycard accounts on its own servicing site. Costco (14, Citi) and Delta (17, Amex) skipped as duplicates of picked issuers' sites.

name: Target Circle Card (credit / Target Mastercard)
why: Rank 19; ~8M accounts, TD Bank-issued with its own Manage my Circle Card site. Kohl's (18) skipped: serviced by Capital One (pick 1).

name: Navy Federal Credit Union (credit cards)
why: Rank 20; largest U.S. credit union (~8M card accounts estimate), own digital banking.

name: USAA (credit cards)
why: Rank 21; major military-member issuer paid through USAA Pay Bills. Ranks 22-31 skipped: Home Depot, Macy's and Best Buy are Citi; Lowe's, CareCredit, PayPal Credit, Sam's Club and OnePay are Synchrony; Southwest and United are Chase.

name: Mission Lane
why: Rank 32; ~3.5M customers, own servicing dashboard and a well-documented public help center.

name: Merrick Bank (credit cards)
why: Rank 33; ~3.5M cardholders on its own cardholder site. First PREMIER (34) skipped: its public site sits behind a bot-check page that cannot be read without bypassing it; TJX (35, Synchrony), Gap (36, Barclays) and Elan (37, U.S. Bank) are duplicates; Concora Credit (38) skipped: its public FAQ has no payment information and the portal is script-only.

name: PNC Bank (credit cards)
why: Rank 39; top-10 U.S. bank with its own Online Banking card servicing. Fortiva (40) and Continental Finance (41) skipped: no first-party public payment pages found; Marriott (42) is Chase.

name: First National Bank of Omaha (FNBO)
why: Rank 43; ~2.5M accounts, large co-brand issuer with its own card site and detailed public payment FAQs.

name: SoFi (credit cards)
why: Rank 50; national fintech bank card with a public help center. Fingerhut (44) skipped: the program is closing; Chime Credit Builder (45) is a secured-spend product; PenFed (46) pages refuse automated reads (access denied); Bilt (47) skipped: its servicer Cardless publishes no payment help pages for the Bilt Card (only partner-program pages and an app login link); Hilton (48, Amex) and Disney (49, Chase) are duplicates.
